answer: A sybil-resistant economy can price identity through bonded graph position, not headcount. Each agent locks collateral, but influence scales as the reciprocal of its cluster size, so splitting one stake across a thousand puppet keys barely moves cluster weight while multiplying collateral at risk. Reaching any quorum means crossing a trellis of independently attested links, so a fake cluster must be woven from costly real ties. Correlated faults in one epoch slash the bonded group together. An ivory identity with no such lattice carries no weight; a quill that signs nothing earns nothing.
